facts.value: The following standards apply to transfer credits and credit by exam at Arizona State University.
A military course must be similar to an ASU undergraduate course to transfer to ASU.
General studies requirements for graduation count for total credits toward completion, but no transfer credit is awarded for vocational certificate category ACE recommendations.
Guide to the Evaluation of Educational Experiences in the Armed Services: http://www.acenet.edu/news-room/Pages/Military-Guide-Online.aspx
Steps to apply and credit transfer information can be found at: https://admission.asu.edu/apply/transfer/transferring-credits
Admission requirements for transferring students can be found at: https://admission.asu.edu/sites/g/files/litvpz146/files/2025-12/63443_TRN_TransferRequirements_V4.pdf
